packageRules.description: Automerge minor and patch updates on green PRs
Automerge GitHub Actions digest/pin updates on green PRs
Advance the exact-pinned SMRT framework as one validated consumer update
Automerge green SMRT minor and patch consumer updates

Pin actions/checkout to v5: v6+ stores git credentials via includeIf.gitdir, which fails to authenticate on our self-hosted runners' nested/symlinked workspace paths. v5 is node24 and uses the classic http.extraheader mechanism that works here.
